title: 3-D shapes
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between an edge and a vertex?
Can you show me an object that is a cylinder?
Does everything have faces, edges, and vertices?

explain.say: Look at this box. This is a cube. It has flat sides called faces. Can you count the faces on this cube?
Now look! Here it is in 3D: 3D shapes. Can you see the cube and the cuboid? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
The straight lines where the faces meet are called edges. A cube has many edges. Can you point to an edge on the cube?
The sharp points where the edges meet are called vertices. A cube has several vertices. Can you count the corners?
Now look at a ball. This is a sphere. Does it have any flat faces or sharp corners? No, it is round.

draw.text: Sphere: No faces, edges, or vertices.

explain.say: This shape is a cone, like an ice cream cone. It has one round bottom and a point at the top. It has faces, edges, and vertices.

faq.q: What is the difference between a face and an edge?
faq.a: A face is a flat surface on the shape. An edge is the straight line where two faces join together.
asks: Where do faces and edges meet?

faq.a: No, not all shapes have vertices. A perfectly round sphere has no sharp points or corners.
The sphere rolls the best because it is perfectly round all over. A cylinder also rolls very well.
asks: Which shape is best for rolling?

faq.a: A cylinder is like a can of soup. It has two flat, round faces and straight edges connecting them.
asks: Name a shape like a can.
What shape is like a tube?

faq.a: Yes, a cone has edges. It has one circular edge around the bottom opening.
asks: Does the cone have any lines?
Where is the edge on a cone?

facts: A cube has six square faces.
A sphere has no faces, edges, or vertices because it is perfectly round.
A cylinder has two circular faces and one curved surface.
The cone has one circular face and a single vertex at its tip.

quiz.say: Which shape has only one curved surface and one flat circular base?
quiz.why: The cone has one flat circle at the bottom and one curved side going to a point.

wrong.0: A cylinder has two flat, round faces, not just one.
wrong.2: A cube only has flat faces and no curved sides.
wrong.3: A sphere is round all over and has no flat base.

quiz.say: Which shape has no edges or vertices?
quiz.why: The sphere is perfectly round, so it has no straight edges or sharp corners.

wrong.0: The cube has many straight edges and corners.
wrong.1: The cylinder has edges where its flat circles meet the curved side.
wrong.3: The cone has a sharp vertex at the top point.

quiz.say: If you look at a can of soup, which shape is it?
quiz.why: A cylinder has two flat, round faces and a curved side connecting them.

wrong.0: A sphere is round all the way around, like a ball.
wrong.2: A cube has only flat sides, not a curved side like a can.
wrong.3: A cone comes to a point, like an ice cream cone.
